errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.SECURE_STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: This computer offers no secure storage, so the key wasn't saved.
errors.FOLDER_NOT_EMPTY: That folder already has files in it. Pick an empty folder.
errors.FOLDER_INSIDE_CURRENT: Pick a folder outside the current one.
errors.LANGUAGE_EXISTS: That language is already on the list.
errors.LANGUAGE_BUILTIN: English and Arabic are always available.
errors.AI_NO_KEY: Add an API key for this provider in Settings first.
errors.AI_AUTH: The provider rejected this key. Check it in Settings.
errors.AI_RATE_LIMIT: The provider's usage limit was reached. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.AI_MODEL_MISSING: The provider doesn't offer this model. Pick another one in Settings.
errors.AI_SERVER: The provider is having trouble right now. Try again in a moment.
errors.AI_TIMEOUT: The provider took too long to answer. Try again.
errors.AI_NETWORK: Couldn't reach the provider. Check your internet connection.
errors.AI_INVALID_OUTPUT: The answer came back in the wrong shape. Try again.
errors.AI_NO_VISION: None of this provider's models can read images.
errors.AUDIO_TOO_LARGE: The recording is too long (25 MB at most). Record a shorter part.
errors.MIC_DENIED: Tatabu isn't allowed to use the microphone. Allow it in your system settings.
errors.NOTHING_TO_COMBINE: None of the chosen files can go into a PDF. Pick PDFs or images.
errors.FILE_MISSING: That file is no longer in the application folder.
